description: This file defines the class CalendarSyncOrchestrator which manages the process of synchronizing calendar accounts and events between external and internal calendars in a CRM system. It includes methods for initializing synchronization, handling individual events, discovering operations, and maintaining sync state and logs.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOrchestrator
classes.description: This class orchestrates synchronization of calendar accounts and events, handling the entire process from fetching, comparing, and updating events, to creating synchronization jobs and maintaining state and logs.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Starts synchronization for all calendar accounts, processing a batch according to configuration limits, and logging progress.

methods.name: getCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves and validates a batch of calendar accounts available for synchronization.

methods.name: syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Synchronizes an individual calendar account, either asynchronously by creating a job or synchronously by fetching and processing events.

methods.name: createAsyncAccountJob
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous job to sync a specific calendar account, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: prepareProvidersAndQuery
methods.description: Prepares the external and internal calendar providers and constructs the query object for fetching events.

methods.name: fetchAndEnrichEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events within the sync window and enriches the list by fetching linked events outside the window.

methods.name: discoverAndExecuteOperations
methods.description: Discovers synchronization operations and executes or queues them, respecting maximum limits.

methods.name: finalizeSyncAccount
methods.description: Logs final results and updates the last synchronization state for an account.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Processes a specific calendar event operation (create, update, delete), either asynchronously or synchronously, updating providers accordingly.

methods.name: updateLastSyncDate
methods.description: Updates the record of the last successful synchronization date.

methods.name: updateLastSyncAttemptDate
methods.description: Marks the attempt timestamp and status for synchronization.

methods.name: updateSyncAttemptResult
methods.description: Updates logs reflecting the result of a sync attempt, indicating success, partial sync, or errors.

methods.name: updateSyncAttemptError
methods.description: Flags a sync attempt as failed due to errors.
